overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission approved multiple manager changes, one-day special licenses, and the 2024 annual license renewals. The commission also designated two new police officers as board agents and voted to adopt Chapter 138, Section 33B into city records to allow Sunday morning alcohol sales.

items.title: Medford Professional Firefighters Club Change of Manager and Entertainment License
items.summary: Approved a change of manager to Steven M. Moore and an entertainment license for karaoke and a jukebox, with Commissioner Delafano recused as a club member.

items.title: American Legion Post 45 Change of Manager
items.summary: Approved the change of manager to Thomas Moulton, conditioned on correcting the signatory name on page 5 of the application.

items.title: Event Dem Studios One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved a rescheduled one-day license for December 20 and advised the applicant that a separate permit was not required for an invitation-only holiday party.

items.title: City of Medford Community Preservation Committee One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a January 21, 2024 anniversary celebration moved to the Unitarian Universalist Church due to accessibility issues.

items.title: Designation of Police Officers as Licensing Board Agents
items.summary: Approved designating Medford Police Officers Patrick Smith and Brian Sebastian as official agents of the liquor licensing board.

items.title: Adoption of Chapter 138, Section 33B
items.summary: Voted to officially record the adoption of Massachusetts General Law Chapter 138, Section 33B to permit on-premise alcohol sales beginning at 10 a.m. on Sundays and legal holidays.

items.title: Riverside Yacht Club Change of Manager
items.summary: Approved the change of manager application for Michael Giardina following the receipt of outstanding documentation.

items.title: 2024 Retail Liquor License Renewals
items.summary: Approved the 2024 annual liquor license renewals across all categories, noting that Smashburger and Salvatore's did not seek renewal.

items.title: 2024 Population Increase Estimation
items.summary: Approved the estimated resident population certification form projecting 65,399 residents for submission to the ABCC quota determination.
